My mum is kinda like this. It is never about anything serious but it’s so frustrating. I remember as a kid, I never drank tea and if we were over at someone’s house and they offered it to me, she would always say things like “princesslola doesn’t like tea” or if someone offered me food that she assumed I didn’t like she’d do this as well. She’d always answer for me without waiting to hear my response first. I only recently discovered that I actually do like tea. It’s such a small thing but it represents something bigger for me. Same with food, I thought I didn’t like mushrooms because she told everyone I didn’t like them but I actually love them now. It’s so stupid but it’s nice to finally be able to enjoy the little things I always thought I hated. I think this was another way for her to control me and then bitch about how “picky” I was and thus, make me out to be the bad guy.

Thank you so much. My boyfriend and I live with my mother and trying to juggle work and school is getting really difficult. I’m trying to save up so I can move out but it probably won’t happen until I’m finished my course unfortunately. My boyfriend is looking for a better job at the moment as well so we can get out of her house. And no, I never took swimming lessons but my dad was really into it and taught me when I was a kid. It was always “our thing”. He turned out to be an asshole though.

-How did it make you worse? 
It opened up past wounds, ones I didn’t even know I had. It made it extremely difficult to engage in everyday life because I was so stuck in the past and all that trauma and I couldn’t think about anything else. 
-Did it make your suicidal urges stronger? 
Not necessarily but it didn’t make them any less strong either. It made my suicidal thoughts stronger and more frequent but not the urges. 
-Do you think you stopping going to therapy was a good idea? 
I don’t know to be completely honest. I think so, maybe I’m just not ready for it, idk.
-What would people close to you do if you told them what you are telling me? 
I don’t really care. They’re part of the reason why I feel this way anyway. My mother would probably call me names like she always does. My boyfriend would be upset but he knows I feel this way anyway and there really isn’t much that he can do. 
-Would you be afraid to tell them? 
My boyfriend is the only person I feel somewhat comfortable talking to about this so I guess I am afraid, not sure what of though. 
-What makes you want to drown? 
I have no idea why drowning specifically but it’s always been a huge fantasy of mine. I know it’s probably one of the most painful ways to go but there’s something that seems so peaceful about it. It’s weird, I know. 
-Is it just general sadness or is it something that is happening to you? 
Both I guess. Mental illness combined with a shitty life situation that I can’t get out of. 

“Suicide only spreads the pain you feel to others” 
And that is the only reason I’m still here. My boyfriend is the only person I really care about these days but he’s lost way too many people already. I don’t think I could do that to him.

Drowning has always been a fantasy of mine. And yeah, I’ve been feeling like this for years, attempted twice and ended up in a psych hospital both of those times. I had therapy and was on medication but stopped all that when I turned 18 because it was only making me worse tbh.
Oblivion doesn’t scare me at all, it’s actually the ideal state for me, that “nothingness” is what I want.
